intro: Four pathways to support your vitality. Each one starts with a simple first step, then is shaped with you.

parcours.titre: Coming out of exhaustion and calming your nervous system
parcours.chapeau: Fatigue is settling in, your sleep does not restore you, and your mind will not stop. You keep everything running, and you are starting to lose yourself along the way.
parcours.image_alt: A participant, eyes closed, breathes beneath the timber frame of the Dome
signaux: You sleep, but you wake up already tired.
Your thoughts spin in the evening and will not stop.
Your patience wears thin, and your reactions rise faster than before.
Listening to others, even the people you love, takes an effort.
You hold the home, the job and the family together, and you wonder how much longer you can.

etapes.texte: 80 minutes with a naturopath to take stock of your 7 axes and spot what wears you down first: sleep, mental load, digestion, deficiencies.
etapes.label: Book the consultation

etapes.texte: In 2 hr 50, you move through a face and foot reflexology with sound journey, an IHHT Mitovit session, then QRS and Airnergy, to bring your nervous system back down.
etapes.label: See the half-day

etapes.texte: You begin with a 90-minute naturopathy consultation, then receive a one-hour massage, IHHT Mitovit, QRS and Airnergy, infrared light and a magnesium salt bath, with a lunch at the centre.
etapes.label: See the full day

etapes.titre: Five days to put it all down
etapes.texte: When fatigue has set in, the immersive retreat gives your body the time that a half-day cannot give: four nights, consultations, care, sessions and anti-inflammatory cooking.
etapes.label: See the retreats

soins: Face and foot massage & sound journey
Face and foot reflexology with sound journey, in-depth ritual

parcours.chapeau: Bloating, recurring discomfort, a temperamental digestion. Your belly speaks first, and often long before the rest of you. We listen to it with you.
parcours.image_alt: A bowl of noodles with vegetables and fresh herbs, prepared by the hoona chef
signaux: You feel bloated after meals, even mildly.
Your transit is irregular, and you feel heaviness and reflux.
Your energy rises and falls, and you crave sugar in the afternoon.
Your test results are normal, and yet something is off.
Your digestion goes off track as soon as stress rises.

etapes.texte: 80 minutes with a naturopath to take stock of your 7 axes. The consultation also explores your digestion: your plate, your meal rhythm and your stress, with personalised recommendations.
etapes.label: Book the consultation

etapes.texte: In 2 hr 30, you receive Chi Nei Tsang or Indiba, an hour of reflexology, then a liver compress or a Papimi session, to get your digestion moving again.
etapes.label: See the half-day

etapes.texte: You begin with a 90-minute naturopathy consultation, then receive Indiba on the abdomen, Chi Nei Tsang or reflexology, Papimi, a liver compress and infrared light, with a lunch at the centre.
etapes.label: See the full day

etapes.texte: Four nights in the guesthouse, anti-inflammatory cooking at every meal, consultations, care and sessions: you have the time to build new habits, away from daily life.
etapes.label: See the retreats

parcours.chapeau: A real pause to slow down, set down what you carry and come back to yourself. It can be a few hours, a full day, or five days away from daily life.
parcours.image_alt: A gong and bowls in the light of the Dome
signaux: You have not taken time for yourself in months.
You function, without really being there.
The weekend is no longer enough to recover.
You need to set things down, not to perform.
You would like someone to look after you, for once.

etapes.texte: 80 minutes with a naturopath to set down what you carry, take stock of your 7 axes and choose the pause that suits you.
etapes.label: Book the consultation

etapes.texte: In 2 hr 15, you receive a one-hour targeted massage, then enjoy the private sauna and a magnesium salt bath, so you can let go without having to decide anything.
etapes.label: See the half-day

etapes.texte: You receive two one-hour targeted massages, with the private sauna, a magnesium salt bath, infrared light, QRS and Airnergy, and a lunch at the centre.
etapes.label: See the full day

etapes.texte: From Monday to Friday, in a small group, in the guesthouse: consultations, care, sessions and full board. You have the time to let go and leave with a new rhythm.
etapes.label: See the dates

soins: Face and foot massage & sound journey
Face and foot reflexology with sound journey, in-depth ritual

parcours.chapeau: Look after your vitality while you are well, and make it last. There is nothing smarter than taking care of your health before your body protests.
parcours.image_alt: A group doing Nordic walking under the trees of Tervuren park
signaux: You are doing well and you want it to last.
You feel that daily life clogs you up: screens, alcohol, sugar and information overload.
You look for reliable landmarks in a world of miracle remedies.
You want to understand your body before it sounds the alarm.
You like to move, outdoors, and you would like more regularity.

etapes.texte: 80 minutes with Olivia and a therapist to assess your 7 axes and know which one to support first. At the centre or remotely.
etapes.label: Book the assessment

etapes.texte: In 2 hr 15, you move through Papimi, QRS and Airnergy, the private sauna and a magnesium salt bath, to support detox and get ahead.
etapes.label: See the half-day

etapes.texte: You begin with a 90-minute naturopathy consultation, then move through Papimi, QRS and Airnergy, the private sauna, a magnesium salt foot bath, infrared light and a one-hour massage, with a lunch at the centre.
etapes.label: See the full day

etapes.texte: Five days to get ahead: four nights in the guesthouse, consultations, care, movement and anti-inflammatory cooking. Prevention on a grand scale.
etapes.label: See the retreats

soins: One-to-one holistic assessment, at the centre

_aide_etapes: Each step carries a phase: point (Take stock), experimenter (Experience) or immerger (Immerse). Neighbouring steps of the same phase are grouped under one heading. principal: true = the step used by the header button (otherwise the first). Four steps per pathway.
